items.title: September intake now open
items.body: Our next Beginner Course intake starts 1 September. Spaces are limited to 15 learners per group — book early to secure a morning slot.

items.title: New evening slots in Karonga & Mzuzu
items.body: By popular request, the Karonga & Mzuzu branches now offer 17:30–18:30 lessons on weekdays for learners who work during the day.

items.title: Motorcycle course now includes night riding practice
items.body: We've extended the Motorcycle Course to include a supervised night-riding session, covering visibility and hazard awareness after dark.
